originalTitle: You’re probably too invested in equities. Why a 60-40 portfolio is still the smart way to go.
summary: For most of U.S. history, an all-stock and a 60-40 portfolio have run neck-and-neck for trailing 30-year returns.
content: For most of U.S. history, an all-stock and a 60-40 portfolio have run neck-and-neck for trailing 30-year returns.
